name: Verna
tagline: Small republic, home of the University
summary: A small independent republic neighbouring Vesper, famous above all as the home of the University of Verna.
history: Verna survives on treaties and guarantees from neighbouring powers rather than a large standing army. Centuries ago, scholars fleeing the **Silencing of the Schools**, when an older Kharadi predecessor conquered the Old Scholastic Coast and violently suppressed heterodox intellectual and religious traditions, helped turn Verna's existing colleges into the modern University.

relations.text: Trades with it, but stays especially wary of depending on Kharadi credit or patronage.

sponsorFraming: The Recruitment Faction is the **University of Verna**, which sponsors scholars and specialists from anywhere: being sponsored by the University is not the same as being Vernan.
extraRule: Once between expeditions, when you make a Research Project Action, gain +1 additional Progress if the University's laboratories, archives, specialists or equipment could reasonably assist you.
